changes.description: JPA 2.2 (`javax.persistence`) support. Every release also publishes the same library as a jar with the `javax` classifier, tested on Hibernate 5.6 and EclipseLink 2.7.
Runs on Java 8, down from Java 11.
Compiled against Jakarta Persistence 3.0, down from 3.1. Works with Hibernate 5.6 (`hibernate-core-jakarta`), Hibernate 6 and 7, and EclipseLink 3.0 and newer.
Text, advanced text and quick filters add the `ESCAPE` clause to `LIKE` only when the filter text holds `%`, `_`, `!` or a backslash, as Oracle is slower with it.

Tree data matches descendants with `LIKE` and `LOCATE` together, so the database can use an index on the data path column. Override `createTreeDataDescendantPredicate` if paths hold other characters special to `LIKE`, such as `[` on SQL Server or a backslash with EclipseLink.
`%` and `_` typed into the text, advanced text or quick filter acted as wildcards. They now match literally.
`%` or `_` in a tree data path made unrelated nodes count as descendants in child counts, aggregation and filtering.
A value column whose name contains the pivot separator (`current_value` with the default `_`) resolved to the wrong column, so sorting or filtering its pivot result columns failed.
Pivoting on a `LocalDateTime` column merged values from the same day into one result column. Pivot keys are now the full date-time (`2024-01-10T09:00:00`), not the date.
Row grouping threw a `NullPointerException` for a request built without a filter model.

`countRows` counts the level the request loads: the root groups, the child groups of an expanded group, or the rows of a fully expanded group. It used to count the root groups unless `paginateChildRows` was set.
`paginateChildRows` has no effect and will be removed.
Custom advanced filter options, registered with `registerCustomAdvancedFilter(type, factory)`.
Advanced filter on set columns (`isAnyOf`, `isNoneOf`), values parsed by the column's `AgSetColumnFilter`.
`AgSetColumnFilter.toPredicate` is public.
Advanced filter on date columns accepts the named and relative date ranges (`today`, `lastWeek`, `last30Days`, …).
Advanced filter `inRange` on number and date columns, honouring `inRangeInclusive` and `includeBlanksInRange`.
`streamRows`: a lazy stream of every row the request matches, read in chunks of `streamChunkSize` (default 1000).

The zone of the zoned date filters moved from the factory to `DateFilterParams.zoneId`, default UTC: `forInstant(zone)` becomes `forInstant()` with `DateFilterParams.builder().zoneId(zone)`. Same for `forOffsetDateTime`, `forZonedDateTime`, `forUtilDate` and `forTimestamp`.
Relative date options resolve "now" in `zoneId` instead of the JVM's default zone. Set `zoneId(ZoneId.systemDefault())` to keep the old behaviour.
The date column filter accepts `dateFrom` and `dateTo` as `yyyy-MM-dd` and `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss`, not only `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`.
Columns from a `@MappedSuperclass`: `ColDef.builder` and `FieldPath.of` take a `SingularAttribute<? super E, T>`.

`ColumnSource.getExpression`, `FieldPath.getPath` and the `ComputedField` expression function take `Root<? extends E>` instead of `Root<E>`. Custom `ColumnSource` implementations, and `ComputedField` lambdas that declare their parameter types, need the new signature.
Column, quick and external filters were ignored in pivot mode. They now restrict the rows, and filters on pivot result columns filter the aggregated values.
`alwaysAppliedDetailPredicate` on `MasterDetailParams`.
`alwaysAppliedPredicate`: a predicate added to every query, set filter values and tree data child counts included.
Computed columns: `ColDef.builder` takes a `ColumnSource`, either a `FieldPath` or a `ComputedField` built from any criteria expression.
`includeRowCountInLoadSuccessParams` returns the row count with the rows.
`toBuilder()` on `ColDef`, the filter params, the request and the response classes.
`ServerSideGetRowsRequest.builder()` defaults its lists to empty ones.
Queries select with `cb.tuple(...)` instead of the deprecated `multiselect`.
The `blank` option of the text filter and the advanced text filter compares `LENGTH(value) = 0` instead of `value = ''`.
First stable release, the same code as 0.0.54.
